sections.design_notes: High contrast Red background with Black text. Counter-skew the inner content so it remains flat while the background is angled. Use pure brutalism here.

sections.design_notes: Use the Tetris Grid (Mode A). Cards should use the brutalist_card style with neon borders. Use the provided screenshot image URLs as background/foreground assets inside the cards, masking them creatively.

technical_requirements.fonts: Include Anton, Outfit, and JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts in index.css
technical_requirements.animations: Use Framer Motion for scroll-triggered entrances (fade + slight translateY). Use Lenis for smooth scrolling.
technical_requirements.testing: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, nav links, cards).
technical_requirements.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Fill) or lucide-react. Keep them chunky to match the brutalist style.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do NOT use gradients unless it's a harsh brutalist halftone or scanline effect.
Borders should be thick (2px or 4px) and high contrast. Rounded corners should be minimal (rounded-none or rounded-sm max) to maintain the brutalist edge.

For the screenshots, since they are sprite sheets/collages in the provided URLs, use CSS object-fit: cover and object-position to frame interesting parts of the images, or display the whole collage inside a slick card.
Use uppercase heavily for headings. Letter spacing should be tight for headings (tracking-tighter) to look like a punk rock poster.
Ensure the neon lime (#D4FF00) and crimson red (#FF2D2D) pop aggressively against the black (#0A0A0A) background.
DO NOT add soft dropshadows. Only use hard, solid 0px blur shadows (e.g., shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_#D4FF00]).
When injecting images, rely ONLY on the provided media_assets URLs. No placeholders.
Implement the 'marker highlight' effect precisely as defined in typography.effects for key phrases.
